findings.highlight: She licks her lips as she stares down at me.
findings.evidenceJa: ビルの五階付近に張り付いたソレは、ぬらりと舌なめずりをして、俺を見た。
findings.governingReading: After the attack Rider is seen clinging near the fifth floor, licking her lips and looking at him.
findings.explanation: The fifth-floor sighting loses its height.

findings.highlight: Like Rider, Saber moves along the side of the building, striking at her with dizzying speed!
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーはライダー同様、ビルの側面を蹴って、稲妻のようにライダーへ襲いかかった—！
findings.governingReading: She kicks the building’s side, and the shadows collide, separate, kick off again and recollide.
findings.explanation: Wall kicks and successive rebounds become generic movement along the building.
